brief: Count pallets across each image. Just show the count, with no alert or event trigger.
Count pallets in the saved lanes A, B, C and D, separately for each lane. No alerts.
Count only pallets whose centers are inside lane B. Use its saved boundary; do not count the other lanes.
Count pallets in each saved lane and create a local event when a lane has at least 5 pallets.
Count pallets in saved lanes A and B and flag a lane when it has at least 8 pallets for 12 seconds.
Count pallets per saved lane. Evaluate count_mae target 0.25. No event trigger.
Count pallets in each saved lane and alert when a lane is full.
Count pallets in lanes A and B separately. No alerts.
Count pallets only inside lane E. Use its actual boundary. No alerts.
Detect people in each image and show their bounding boxes. Use confidence 0.3 and evaluate recall target 0.85. No event trigger.
Detect forklifts and create a local evidence event whenever at least one forklift appears.
Detect bolts and washers using the exact saved classes bolt and washer. Use confidence 0.25. Do not create events.
Detect the object class person. The annotation label is person; do not read printed text. Use precision target 0.9.
Detect damaged cartons using class damaged carton and create a local event for each frame with at least one. Evaluate recall target 0.9.
Find damaged cartons and damaged pallets for review; use the saved classes damaged carton and damaged pallet. Save evidence when either appears.
Detect crushed cartons using the class crushed carton. Use confidence 0.2 and recall target 0.95. Show boxes only, without events.
Read the printed text on these package labels and show the recognized text. No comparison is needed.
Read the barcodes on these packages and show the decoded codes. No expected code or comparison.
Read the printed label and create a local event when it contains SKU-001.
Read package barcodes and check whether the decoded value contains ABC-990.
Read these labels and compare them against the expected SKU.
Check whether each barcode matches the correct package code.
Read printed labels and check for ITEM-882. Evaluate text_accuracy target 0.97.
Read package labels and show their codes.
